candidates.description: This feature vector represents medical conditions, patient demographics, and healthcare-related statistics across multiple languages.
This feature vector represents the concept of spreading or contracting diseases and pathogens.
This vector represents the concept of defense, safety, and preventative measures against harm or unwanted outcomes.
This vector represents biological pathogens, infections, and related medical immunizations.
This vector represents adjectives and adverbs related to magnitude, speed, and degree of change.
This vector represents the concept of the COVID-19 pandemic and its global societal impacts.
This vector represents quantifiers denoting an indefinite number of items or amounts across multiple languages.
This vector represents empirical investigations, outcomes, and the causal relationships between actions and their consequences.
These tokens represent noun and adverbial suffixes related to action, state, or manner, predominantly in Romance languages.
This vector represents German auxiliary, modal, and copula verbs conjugated across various tenses, persons, and moods.
